C1333.title: Massive ClickFix Phishing Campaign Targets Hotel Systems to Spread PureRAT Remote Access Trojan
C1333.summary: In November 2025, Sekoia disclosed a large-scale ClickFix phishing campaign targeting hotel systems. Attackers impersonated Booking.com and used compromised email accounts to send spear-phishing messages, embedding videos, countdowns, and recent verification user counters in fake verification pages. They induced hotel managers to copy and run malicious commands, ultimately distributing the PureRAT remote access trojan. The campaign exploited the hotel sector high trust in booking-platform notifications and disguised manual command execution as a verification step, improving remote-access trojan delivery success.
